purpose: Add another item to an existing set of circumstances.
keywords: The room is spacious. On top of that, you can see the sea from the window.
It started raining, and on top of that the wind grew stronger.
She lent me the tools. She even showed me how to use them.
restrictions: The additional item reinforces a positive or negative situation.
mistake: This conjunction is not a physical “on top of it”.

segments.role: Add another item to an existing set of circumstances. その上 + clause

examples.translation: The room is spacious. On top of that, you can see the sea from the window.
